text: {"lessons":["A few losing months can materially reduce my account value, so I should diversify and avoid letting any one stock dominate my risk.","Selling Stock D at a large loss reminded me to set clear reasons for buying and selling rather than making reactive decisions; I should review those reasons calmly.","Buying more stocks after prices fell is not automatically a bargain. I should check my plan and keep enough cash instead of adding just to lower my average cost."]}
